title: KRONOS WORLDWIDE, INC. ANNOUNCES EXPECTED SECOND QUARTER 2026 EARNINGS RELEASE DATE
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Kronos Worldwide, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
DALLAS, TEXAS, July 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kronos Worldwide, Inc. (NYSE: KRO) announced today that, subject to the completion of quarter-end closing procedures, it expects to report second quarter 2026 earnings in a press release after market close on Wednesday, August 5, 2026.


Kronos Worldwide, Inc. is a major international producer of titanium dioxide products.
